name: JoAi: Update Contact Relation

description.en: Update an existing relation between two CRM contacts — change its type, edit its note, or replace its structured metadata. Changing the type re-points the relation correctly (for example from parent_of to manages) and is rejected if that relation already exists. The linked contacts are preserved. List the contact's relations first to find the relation ID.
description.de: Aktualisiere eine bestehende Beziehung zwischen zwei CRM-Kontakten — ändere den Typ, bearbeite die Notiz oder ersetze die strukturierten Metadaten. Beim Ändern des Typs wird die Beziehung korrekt neu ausgerichtet (z. B. von parent_of zu manages) und abgelehnt, wenn diese Beziehung bereits existiert. Die verknüpften Kontakte bleiben erhalten. Liste zuerst die Beziehungen des Kontakts auf, um die Beziehungs-ID zu finden.

bot: Use this to change the type of an existing relation, add or change its note, or replace its structured metadata. The relation type is read from this contact's point of view; changing it may reverse which contact is the subject. If the relation ID is unknown, list the contact's relations first.

inputs.name: Relation type

description.en: The new relation type, read from this contact's point of view: parent_of, child_of, spouse_of, sibling_of, friend_of (personal friendship, not business partner_of), aunt_of, nibling_of, manages, reports_to, colleague_of, partner_of, client_of, supplier_of, referred_by, or referred. Omit to keep the current type.

Weglassen, um den aktuellen Typ beizubehalten.

inputs.bot: Optional new relation type from this contact's point of view. Same types as create: family; Personal/Social friend_of (not business partner_of); organization; business; referral. Symmetric types (spouse_of, sibling_of, colleague_of, partner_of, friend_of) only need one record. Omit to keep the current type. Changing to a relation that already exists is rejected.
